Keep every existing byte, then add a SECOND paragraph (separated by the same escaped paragraph break the field already ends with) whose text is EXACTLY: The kitchen was wrong at a glance. Michelle's chair lay tipped over at her workstation across the room, and her tablet and work bag were nowhere in sight. A mug sat on the workstation beside a stack of manuscript pages. The calendar and the lake photograph hung by the refrigerator, where they always had. Kristin was too frantic to read any of it yet. She called Michelle's name.  The field must still end with the escaped paragraph break like today. It names only what is visible from the doorway and states no meaning: it must contain none of these words (case-insensitive): splinter, outward, lukewarm, warm, glasses, Saturday, birthday, KMS, initials, carved, gap, drawer, phone, card, deadbolt. Add one sentence to the plot.md 1A.1 prose saying that Kristin takes in the room at a glance on arrival but is too frantic to read it yet, and that a few turns in, once she steadies herself, she reads the back door properly.

P2. NO FIRST-TURN DEDUCTION FROM ORIENTING COMMANDS, a timed beat instead. Do NOT change action_evidence or any field of knowledge record k_sl_1a_a_r1 or storylet SL-1A-A (examining the kitchen or the back door still earns the deduction as today). Fields: id kristin_steadies_1a, scene_id 1A, trailing true, at_turn 3, when [michelle_abduction_suspicion equals false], effects [michelle_abduction_suspicion equals true], one realization with verbatim true and text EXACTLY: Kristin makes herself stop and look properly. Michelle's phone is still here, undamaged. Then she sees the back door. The splinters around the frame point outward, away from the house. A door forced from outside would splinter inward. Someone broke this one from inside to make it look like a break-in. It looks staged.  It fires once at turn 3 if the player has not already earned the deduction (by examining the door or kitchen); it never fires after the deduction was earned. Mirror it in the pacing_event_review list of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/data/stories/continuity-initiative/storylet-routes.yaml directly after the reyes_rams_drawer_1a entry: event_id kristin_steadies_1a, scene_id 1A, at_turn 3, effect assert michelle_abduction_suspicion true, status approved, reason 'Lets Kristin read the forced back door once the first shock passes, without naming who broke in.' If any loader rule requires more (check how reyes_rams_drawer_1a is declared everywhere: grep for it under /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/data/stories/continuity-initiative, /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/storygame and /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/docs), mirror it.

P3. DRAWER HINT WITHOUT THE GAP. In /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/data/stories/continuity-initiative/handoffs.yaml the cue_text of the scene-1A delivery (fact continuity_initiative_known) becomes EXACTLY: Kristin's initials, KMS, are carved into a drawer of Michelle's workstation.  (the gap sentences are dropped: the gap is found only by opening then closing the drawer, per Round 2c). Nothing else in that delivery changes.

P4. THE REST OF THE HOUSE. In /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/data/stories/continuity-initiative/plot.md the 1A front matter setting_facts list gets a THIRD line, appended after the two existing lines, EXACTLY: The rest of the house is quiet. Michelle is not in it.  Add the sentence 'The rest of the house is quiet and empty; Michelle is not in it.' to plot.md 1A.1 prose.

BUDGET (hard rule): tests/test_audit_budget.py::test_real_package_ratchet and tests/fixtures/deep_turn_budget.json must stay UNCHANGED and pass; scene 1A measures about 5330 / 5556 against pins 5485 / 5597 and the P4 line costs about 55 characters. WRITE THESE TESTS, exact names:
1. test_entry_text_keeps_the_old_opening_and_adds_the_glance: entry_text starts with the previous opening (everything up to and including 'She found the back door forced and let herself into the kitchen.'), then contains the GLANCE text exactly, and still ends with a paragraph break.

3. test_kristin_steadies_event_is_declared: the exact event in P2 (id, scene, trailing, at_turn, both predicates, effect, verbatim True, text equal to the STEADY text) and the pacing_event_review entry with status approved.

5. test_examining_the_door_early_earns_the_deduction_and_the_beat_stays_silent_control: first command 'Inspect the back door.' then two 'Wait and observe.': the splinter sentence ('The splinters around the frame point outward') appears exactly once across the three turns and the STEADY text never appears.
6. test_orienting_commands_do_not_earn_the_deduction_on_turn_one_control: for 'Look around.', 'Examine the room.', 'Search the house for Michelle.', 'Call out for Michelle.' as a fresh first command, no segment of turn 1 contains 'splinters'.
7. test_the_drawer_hint_names_only_the_carving: the scene-1A delivery cue_text equals 'Kristin's initials, KMS, are carved into a drawer of Michelle's workstation.' exactly and contains neither 'gap' nor 'lower edge'; and for a fresh first command 'Look around.' the composed turn contains that cue text but no 'gap'.
8. test_the_workstation_is_named_in_the_opening_before_the_hint: 'workstation' appears in entry_text, and for a fresh 'Look around.' turn the cue is the last segment (it follows the narrator's prose).
9. test_setting_facts_gain_the_house_line: setting_facts equals exactly ('Sirens carry from the next street.', 'A dog barks behind the empty house next door.', 'The rest of the house is quiet. Michelle is not in it.').
10. test_the_house_line_reaches_the_narrator_on_a_house_search: capture the request body of the narrator call for the command 'Search the house for Michelle.' (stub urlopen records request.data) and assert the body contains 'The rest of the house is quiet. Michelle is not in it.'.
11. test_scene_1a_budget_pins_are_untouched_control: tests/fixtures/deep_turn_budget.json scene 1A has narration_chars 5485 and narration_chars_all_alternates 5597.
Tests 1, 3, 4, 7, 9, 10 must FAIL against today's data for the right reason. Test 2 may pass vacuously on the withheld words today; make it also assert the glance words so it fails today.
